article.title: The more…, the more…
article.part: Construcciones avanzadas y fenómenos excepcionales — Advanced constructions and exceptional phenomena
article.chapter: Combinaciones avanzadas de cláusulas — Advanced clause combinations

claims.summary: The English comparative correlative construction connects two scalar changes in the pattern the + comparative clause, the + comparative clause, as in The more you read, the more you learn. Its special the is a correlating marker rather than the ordinary definite article; the comparatives can include more/less, inflected -er forms, and reduced formulations such as The sooner, the better. A correlative statement does not by itself demonstrate causation.
